title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-alpha` and asserts the response contains `Apollo`.
A test calls `get_team` as `user-key` for the seeded alpha team and asserts the returned team id equals `team-alpha`.
A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for the seeded beta project and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA`.
A test calls `update_task` as `user-key` for `task-beta` and asserts the mutation does not succeed.
A test calls `search_tasks` as `user-key` with a query that matches the seeded alpha task and asserts the response contains `SENTINEL_ALPHA_TASK`.
A test calls `get_project` as `admin-key` and asserts the response contains `SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_ALPHA`.
The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or seeded markers, so assertions inspect returned data rather than opaque Go values.
A test calls `search_tasks` as `user-key` for alpha task data and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_REVIEWER_ALPHA`.
The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
A test calls `get_project` as `user2-key` for the seeded beta project and asserts the returned project id equals `project-beta`.
A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `Borealis`.
A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-alpha` and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_ALPHA`.
A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-alpha` and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METRICS_ALPHA`.
A test calls `list_task_comments` as `user-key` for `task-alpha` and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_ALPHA`.
A test calls `summarize_task` as `user-key` for `task-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `SENTINEL_BETA_TASK`.
